tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch2:2-3↗ ex:warped-products Given a smooth embedded $1$-dimensional submanifold $C \subseteq H$ as in Example 2.24(b), show that the surface of revolution $S_C \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ with its induced metric is isometric to the warped product $C \times _a S^1$, where $a: C \to \mathbb {R}$ is the distance to the $z$-axis. \end{exercise}
